semiconductor_relevance: High — CSK specializes in exhaust gas treatment solutions and precursor delivery systems specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CSK Inc. is a manufacturer of treatment solutions for exhaust gases generated during semiconductor and LCD manufacturing. Their products, including scrubbers and delivery systems, are designed to ensure the safe and efficient handling of hazardous gases and ultra-high purity liquids in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: CSK Scrubber for hazardous gas purification
TCT System for ultra-high purity liquid precursor delivery
TDS System for dispensing ultra-high purity liquids
